daily_lesson.explanation_en: Sector rotation is when investors move money from one part of the market to another, for example selling tech stocks and buying retail or healthcare stocks. That's why the NASDAQ can fall noticeably while the S&P 500 barely moves: money is changing places within the market, not leaving it. Watching where money flows can help you find stocks that are gaining strength even on a down day.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 板塊輪動是指投資者將資金從某一板塊轉移至另一板塊，例如沽售科技股，轉而買入零售或醫療股。這解釋了為何納斯達克指數明顯下跌時，標普500指數卻幾乎持平——資金只是在市場內部換位，並非撤出股市。留意資金流向，有助投資者在大市偏軟的日子，仍能找出逆市走強的股份。

market_education.summary_en: Tech-heavy stocks fell more than the overall market today, with the NASDAQ down 0.9% and the S&P 500 down only 0.2%, which means investors moved money between sectors instead of leaving the market. Many of the screened stocks showing strength, like retailers (BURL, KSS, DKS, DLTR, ANF) and biotech names, are outside big tech, which points to money moving into consumer and healthcare stocks ahead of the holiday shopping season. No news headlines were provided today, so this explanation comes only from price and sector patterns and doesn't cite specific reports.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日科技股跑輸大市，納斯達克指數下跌0.9%，標普500指數則僅微跌0.2%，反映資金在板塊之間輪動，而非全面撤離股市。從篩選結果來看，走勢強勁的個股多屬科技以外的板塊，例如零售股（BURL、KSS、DKS、DLTR、ANF）及生物科技股，顯示資金在年末購物旺季前轉向消費及醫療板塊。由於今日未有提供新聞標題，以上分析僅根據股價及板塊走勢作出，並未引用具體報道。
